must: Keep the site dependency-free and compatible with GitHub Pages
avoid: React-only components in the static site

decisions.name: Behavioral research studio
decisions.rationale: An editorial Swiss-inspired system balances academic authority with a distinctive, contemporary personality.

decisions.name: Measured native motion
decisions.rationale: Use staggered entrances, scroll progress, portrait depth, and micro-interactions without migrating the static site to React.

decisions.name: Warm archival palette
decisions.rationale: Warm cream surfaces and coffee typography create an editorial base; burgundy carries primary actions and golden ochre adds restrained emphasis.

decisions.name: Unified degree highlight
decisions.rationale: Ph.D., Master's, and Bachelor's titles share one burgundy treatment on a delicate tinted background, creating a calm and consistent education marker in the timeline.

evidence: Framer Motion principles for variants, scroll, transforms, gestures, and reduced motion
